notes: Conditional (rule-based) TA-Lib strategies with bracket exits, searched against a target of a 40% win rate at 2:1 reward-to-risk (profit factor >= 1.33 net of costs) and 600 net ticks per session day. Code src/ml/ta_strategy/{rules,bracket,rule_search}.py; lake derived_ta_rule_strategies_600_ticks_*; reference docs/ta-strategy-600-ticks.md. Rules are chosen on the in-sample span and judged on the out-of-sample span; a random-entry baseline with the same brackets shows what the bracket alone produces.

1.title: TA-Lib rule families x filters x stops x timeframes, 2:1 brackets
1.hypothesis: Some TA-Lib conditions, as entries into a 2:1 bracket, win at least 40% of trades net of costs (profit factor >= 1.33) out of sample. A random entry into the same bracket wins about 33% before costs, so a qualifying rule must add roughly 7 percentage points of win rate. 600 ticks/day additionally needs trades/day x (0.2 x stop - 5.56) >= 600.
